display_name: The Five Hundred Martyrs of Nicomedia

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Πεντακόσιοι Μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off. The page names not one of them.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Πεντακόσιοι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page `/2817/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole account is one sentence: «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί Μάρτυρες πίστεψαν στον Χριστό δια της Αγίας Ιουλιανής (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα) και κατόπιν όλοι μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους.» **The company enumerates nobody**, so it is held as one entry on the corpus's standing rule for a synaxis that names no member. The place is the page's own, out of the distich above the life: «Πεντακοσίους εἶδεν ἐκτετμημένους, / Ἡ Νικομήδους Μάρτυρας νικηφόρους» — Nicomedia saw five hundred victorious martyrs cut down. No year, no emperor and no hymn, so no `dates` object; no coordinate is proposed for Nicomedia. The reference to Juliana is the page's own and is the `related` row. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 03.01.2026 (21. децембар ст. ст.) — „Света мученица Јулијана и шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом.“

attestations.note: The company is in the day’s first heading as «шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом», the six hundred and thirty martyrs with her, and the body divides that number EXACTLY as the corpus already holds it: «Беше таквих обраћених пет стотина мушких и стотину тридесет женских» — five hundred men and a hundred and thirty women. This folder is the five hundred, and `hundred-and-thirty-women-martyrs` the rest; the `related` rows both already carry to `juliana-of-nicomedia` stand and the quoted heading is the same for all three, because the heading is what the book prints. THE HEADING ENUMERATES NOBODY and the body names no member, so this stays ONE folder and not five hundred — BRIEF.md §4’s ruling for a company heading that names nobody. WHAT THE ENTRY GIVES THEM: that they were converted on the spot by the sight of the heated furnace that did not scorch her; that the eparch condemned the whole number and had them put to the sword; and that their souls passed over into Paradise. NO `dates`: the book’s «304. године» is attached to HER beheading in a later sentence, and that they died in the same hour is the narrative’s order and not a year the page states for them, so the folder keeps the empty `dates` it had. NO SERBIAN NAME FORM: the heading gives the company a count and not a name, and a form assembled out of «пет стотина мушких» would be a phrase of my making — the Serbian is carried in the quoted heading instead. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).
